name: Return to the Hinterlands
summary: You carry Thadius Grimshade's news of Sharpbeak to Gryphon Master Talonaxe.

sections.title: Where Sharpbeak Is Held
sections.body: Thadius Grimshade has learned where Sharpbeak is held. The gryphon is caged on a high cliff atop Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands. Vile Priestess Hexx, high priestess of the Vilebranch trolls, holds the key. You bring the news to Gryphon Master Talonaxe.

sections.title: Talonaxe's Answer
sections.body: Gryphon Master Talonaxe cannot bear the news that the Vilebranch trolls hold Sharpbeak. He declares that a force must be organized to bring the gryphon back.

faq.q: Who reveals the location of Sharpbeak?
aliases: who tells you where sharpbeak is
faq.answer: Thadius Grimshade reveals where Sharpbeak is held after performing a ritual of divination.
Sharpbeak is caged on a high cliff atop Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Who holds the key to Sharpbeak's cage?
faq.answer: Vile Priestess Hexx, high priestess of the Vilebranch trolls, holds the key to Sharpbeak's cage.

faq.q: Where do you deliver this news?
aliases: where to turn in return to the hinterlands
faq.answer: You deliver the news to Gryphon Master Talonaxe in the Hinterlands.

aliases: what led to return to the hinterlands
faq.answer: Thadius Grimshade had just performed the ritual of divination to find Sharpbeak.
